The role includes managing daily operations, floor management, patient satisfaction, documentation, inventory, vendor coordination, hygiene standards, audits, and regulatory compliance. The Centre Manager ensures smooth coordination among doctors, nurses, embryologists, and other healthcare professionals while maintaining NABH/NABL/ISO standards. title: Clinical Research Scientist - Oncology
description: About Qure.AI: Qure.AI is the world's fastest-growing medical AI company, boasting an impressive 13 FDA and 62 CE marking clearances to date. We develop cutting-edge solutions that significantly enhance patient outcomes across various care domains, including lung cancer, tuberculosis, and stroke. Our innovative technologies have positively impacted over 22 million patients in more than 90 countries worldwide. At Qure.ai, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. About the job Job Title: Clinical Research Scientist – Oncology Department: Operations - Health Economics and Outcomes Research Location: Mumbai or Bangalore, India Years of Experience: 5-8 years Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Key Relationships Vice President – Operations, Operational Research and Impact Measurement Job Description Qure.ai is seeking an experienced Clinical Research Scientist to lead the design and execution of high-quality clinical research studies that generate evidence for our AI-enabled oncology solutions, with a primary focus on lung health applications in the United States market. This is an India-based full-time role focused on research on AI-enabled novel disease detection pathways within the US healthcare ecosystem. The role will involve developing real-world evidence and prospective study protocols, supporting peer-reviewed scientific dissemination, and partnering with pharmaceutical, academic, and health-system collaborators, including providers and payers across the US. This position requires strong scientific rigour, the ability to translate clinical needs into robust study designs, and comfort operating in the interdisciplinary, fast-paced environments typical of healthcare AI. While prior research experience in oncology and/or lung health is welcomed, a strong foundation in clinical research methodology combined with a genuine interest in AI applications for oncology is what we are most looking for. Roles and Responsibilities Support the design and execution of retrospective, prospective, reader, real-world evidence, validation and implementation studies to demonstrate the clinical utility, real-world impact, and effectiveness of Qure's AI solutions for early detection and improved patient outcomes. Develop study protocols, statistical analysis plans, case report forms, and IRB documentation aligned with US clinical practice workflows. Support real-world evidence (RWE) studies leveraging US data sources, including claims, electronic health records, and oncology registries, often in partnership with pharmaceutical collaborators and academic medical centers. Collaborate with Product, Business Development, and R&D teams to ensure clinical studies align with product adoption and market access goals within the US market. Engage with principal investigators, clinicians, external experts, key opinion leaders, CROs, pharmaceutical stakeholders, and other research partners to validate study designs, ensure rigorous study execution and generate high-quality evidence for publication. Conduct data quality review, ground-truth adjudication processes, study monitoring, and issue resolution in collaboration with clinical, technical and operational stakeholders. Draft scientific manuscripts, abstracts, posters, conference presentations, white papers, technical reports for dissemination of research findings through publication in peer-reviewed journals, conference abstracts, posters, and oral presentations at major oncology and imaging meetings. Conduct targeted and systematic literature reviews to inform study design, protocol development, clinical assumptions, endpoint selection, and publication planning. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the US lung health landscape, including relevant clinical guidelines, screening pathways, reimbursement context, and adoption considerations for AI-enabled technologies. Help translate research findings and real-world evidence on clinical and health system outcomes and into clear scientific narratives for external stakeholders, including clinicians, providers, payers, life sciences partners, and policy stakeholders. Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOPs, study templates, and internal frameworks for clinical research execution at Qure.ai. Ensure high standards of scientific integrity, documentation, regulatory compliance, and reproducibility across all clinical research outputs. Skills and Expertise Master's degree (minimum) in a relevant discipline such as Clinical Research, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Translational Science or a related quantitative field; candidates with MD, MD-PhD, or PhD qualifications are strongly encouraged to apply. 5–8 years of relevant experience in clinical research, real-world evidence generation, or evidence-based medicine within pharmaceutical, medical device, CRO, academic, or healthcare AI environments. Demonstrated experience designing and executing clinical research studies, including protocol development, endpoint definition, study documentation, statistical analysis, and manuscript writing. Familiarity with study designs across observational, prospective cohort studies, randomized controlled trials, and real-world evidence methodologies. Direct experience supporting US-based clinical research and working knowledge of the US healthcare context is a strong advantage. Demonstrated Proficiency in Python or R or similar tools for statistical analysis. Strong grasp of biostatistics including sample size calculations and advanced statistical analysis, especially in multi-centre study designs. Demonstrated scientific writing skills with a track record of peer-reviewed publications, conference proceedings, or other academic outputs. Familiarity with oncology clinical pathways is desirable, however candidates with strong clinical research foundations and a genuine interest in AI applications for oncology and lung health will be given equal consideration. Excellent project management and multi-tasking abilities; ability to own study timelines and budgets and to coordinate across multiple internal teams and external stakeholders. Experience working with global, cross-functional teams; strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical and statistical concepts for non-technical audiences. Self-driven and detail-oriented, with the ability to take ownership of projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Other Considerations The capacity to adapt to fast-paced, changing environments typical of healthcare settings, and to respond swiftly to the evolving needs of the project and stakeholders. An understanding of the importance of patient data security and the ethical considerations in deploying AI in healthcare settings. At Qure.ai You will be part of a rapidly growing organization, with an opportunity to work alongside the best minds in the industry. Competitive compensation and rewards, opportunity to grow with a young company. title: Contracts & Pricing Execution Mgr
description: Manager, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN) Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. What You Will Do As the Manager, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN-based execution of U.S. Medicaid rebate operations within the Contracts & Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Medicaid invoice processing, claim validation, CLD analytics, dispute management, payment package support, reporting, reconciliation, operational controls, documentation, and continuous improvement for a highly regulated U.S. Medicaid operating environment. Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts & Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Medicaid process owners, U.S.-based Government Pricing, Finance, Compliance, Contracting, Market Access, Information Systems, and AIN cross-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit-ready Medicaid execution. The role will provide leadership to AIN-based associates and analysts supporting Medicaid operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for complex states, judgment-based decisions, approvals, and compliance ownership. Key Responsibilities Medicaid Operations Management Lead end-to-end execution of U.S. Medicaid rebate operations within CPE, covering quarter setup, program readiness, invoice intake, claim loading, invoice validation, CLD processing, disputes, payment package preparation, payment execution support, reporting, and reconciliation. Oversee operational delivery for standard-state Medicaid activities transitioning to AIN while ensuring complex-state issues, high-risk exceptions, approvals, and judgment-based decisions are appropriately escalated to ATO retained owners. Manage workloads, state portfolios, invoice cycles, open items, exception inventories, dispute aging, payment timelines, and quarter-close deliverables to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant execution. Establish operational discipline across trackers, KPI reporting, work allocation, service expectations, quality checks, readiness gates, and issue escalation routines. Quarter Setup, Contract / Program Updates & URA Readiness Oversee Medicaid program setup and maintenance activities including supplemental program updates, customer/payee readiness, program term changes, and reference data coordination in Model N. Coordinate with Government Pricing, Contracting, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and ATO Medicaid process owners to ensure pricing, URA publication, and program readiness steps are completed before invoice processing begins. Ensure AIN execution teams follow SOP-aligned controls for AWP, URA, program updates, access reviews, and evidence retention, while ATO retains final oversight for complex contract interpretation and pricing/terms risk decisions. Invoice Processing, Validation & CLD Analytics Lead Medicaid invoice receipt tracking, invoice conversion, Model N upload preparation, and first-pass validation for standard states and repeatable workstreams. Oversee validation activities including units, NDC, reimbursement, URA reasonableness, duplicate discount indicators, ESRD/medical benefit considerations, managed care vs. FFS nuances, and state-specific exception logic. Drive CLD formatting, claim-level analytics, historical utilization review, trend analysis, and exception documentation to support accurate payment and dispute decisions. Ensure complex validation issues, state-specific nuance, high financial exposure, or ambiguous policy interpretation are routed to ATO/US stakeholders with clear evidence and recommendations. Dispute Management, Payment Processing & Financial Controls Oversee dispute identification, dispute code documentation, dispute tracking, resolution follow-up, interest accrual support, and aging governance across Medicaid invoices and adjustments. Lead payment package preparation and review readiness including ROSI, PQAS, remittance support, approval evidence, SAP/Model N reconciliation support, and SharePoint archival documentation. Partner with Finance and ATO retained owners to support GL reconciliation, budget-to-actual review, payment variance analysis, dispute rollforward visibility, and quarter-close controls. Ensure SOX-aligned documentation, review evidence, and decision logs are maintained for audit readiness and financial control requirements. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement Serve as an AIN business operations lead for Model N, Validata, SAP, state portals, AIR/automation, SharePoint repositories, Tableau/Qlik/Power BI reporting, and related Medicaid workflow tools. Partner with Information Systems and ATO process owners on system access readiness, defect resolution, UAT, workflow enhancements, automation opportunities, and process scalability initiatives. Drive SOP, work instruction, decision tree, state-specific exception playbook, training material, and knowledge repository development to reduce SME dependency and strengthen repeatable execution. Use reporting, dashboards, process metrics, and automation opportunities to improve cycle time, first-pass quality, dispute visibility, and operational transparency. People Leadership & Transition Readiness Lead, coach, and develop AIN-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution. Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign-off before independent ownership expands. Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step. Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN. Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations Maintain audit-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance. Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts. Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations. What We Expect Of You We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability. Basic Qualifications Master's degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related discipline. 9–12 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical / biotech operations, managed markets, Medicaid rebate operations, revenue management, finance, pricing, contracting, analytics, or related U.S. healthcare operations. 3+ years of experience leading people, managing operational teams, or leading complex cross-functional delivery in a controlled environment. Experience operating with U.S.-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Government Pricing, Compliance, IT, or Contract Operations. 3+ years of experience leading people or managing operational teams. Experience coordinating structured work across reporting, systems/process support, documentation, controls, or related business operations activities. Preferred Qualifications Deep understanding of U.S. Medicaid Drug Rebate Program operations, Medicaid rebate adjudication, supplemental rebates, CLD processing, dispute management, ROSI/PQAS, and payment package requirements. Experience with Model N Revenue Management / PbN, Validata, Revitas Flex, SAP, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, or comparable revenue management and analytics platforms. Working knowledge of AMP, Best Price, URA, AWP, NDC, 340B duplicate discount concepts, managed care utilization, ESRD/medical claims considerations, and Gross-to-Net operations. Experience supporting SOX controls, audit readiness, SOP/work instruction documentation, access reviews, issue management, UAT, and system enhancement activities. Proven ability to lead transition, KT, process standardization, automation, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives in a distributed global operating model. Strong stakeholder management, communication, influencing, escalation management, analytical, and executive-ready reporting skills.

Systems, Documentation & Continuous Improvement Use Model N / PbN, SAP, Validata, SharePoint, state portals, reporting tools, and Microsoft 365 applications to support Medicaid workflow execution. Identify process gaps, manual effort reduction opportunities, recurring exceptions, documentation gaps, and quality improvement ideas. Support audit, SOX, and control review activities by providing complete workpapers and organized documentation. Strong Excel, documentation, reporting, analytical, and follow-through skills. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to Medicaid rebate operations, payer rebates, managed markets finance, claims validation, CLD processing, dispute tracking, rebate adjudication, Gross-to-Net, or pharmaceutical revenue management. Experience with Model N / PbN, Validata, Revitas Flex, SAP, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, or comparable tools. title: Senior Medical Lead
description: At Biocon Biologics, we are creating a model for the future of healthcare for all. We are a leading company in the biosimilars revolution where patients come first. Our ambition is to impact a billion lives and we do this by fostering a culture of affordable innovation, patient centricity and disruptive thinking. We are a multicultural global company where employees have a purpose and passion to work closely with partners and patients. We have proven end to end expertise in the field of biosimilars, from its development, manufacturing, clinical development, regulatory approvals to commercialization. We have a long-term commitment to bring high quality affordable biosimilars to patients all over the globe. About the Role: The Medical Lead will be responsible for driving clinical strategy across the product lifecycle—from Target Product Profile (TPP) development through regulatory submission and approval. This role provides medical oversight for clinical trials, ensures compliance with global regulatory standards, and leads cross-functional collaboration with internal teams, CROs, and regulatory authorities. The position requires strong expertise in clinical development, medical monitoring, and regulatory interactions, particularly for novel biologics and molecules. Key Responsibilities: 1. Clinical Strategy & Development Lead clinical strategy development from TPP through dossier submission to global regulatory authorities (e.g., USFDA, EMA, CDSCO). Contribute to and review Clinical Development Plans (CDP), Investigator's Brochure (IB), and study protocols. Drive clinical development strategies for novel biologics and new molecular entities. Identify and implement approaches for accelerated trial execution with a patient-centric focus. Provide medical rationale and scientific justification for products and therapy areas. 2. Clinical Trial Oversight & Execution Provide medical oversight for clinical trials in compliance with GCP, SOPs, and regulatory requirements. Support study conduct activities including site selection, investigator interactions, and vendor/CRO management. Attend and contribute to study initiation meetings, investigator meetings, and governance boards/committees. Review study-level data, including GCP issue reports, protocol deviations, and safety signals. Conduct medical monitoring, including review of lab alerts, SAEs, and EDC data. Ensure accuracy of trial information in registries such as ClinicalTrials.gov and CTRI. Support database lock (DBL) activities and provide inputs on Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs). 3. Regulatory & Scientific Engagement Lead scientific interactions with regulatory authorities for clinical aspects (IND, IMPD, MAA/CTD submissions). Prepare and review regulatory documents, including briefing books, protocol synopses, safety documents, and annual updates. Support responses to regulatory, marketing, and molecule-related queries. Participate in advisory boards, Clinical Advisory Boards (CAB), DSMB meetings, and regulatory discussions. 4. Medical Writing & Documentation Prepare and review key clinical documents including protocols, ICFs, SAP, DMP, SMP, DSMB charter, MMP, imaging charter, and CSRs. Collaborate with medical writers to review and finalize Clinical Study Reports (CSR), including discussions and conclusions. Provide inputs into statistical outputs and interim analysis (DSMB meetings). 5. Safety & Pharmacovigilance Monitor subject safety throughout clinical trials and review safety data. Collaborate with pharmacovigilance teams for preparation and review of safety documentation. Ensure timely identification, escalation, and resolution of safety concerns. 6. Compliance, Audits & Quality Ensure adherence to GCP, regulatory requirements, and internal SOPs. Support audits and regulatory inspections. Contribute to SOP development, review, and continuous process improvements. 7. Stakeholder & Team Management Manage interactions with CROs, vendors, investigators, and cross-functional teams. Line manage and mentor medical/scientific staff (if applicable). Participate in external scientific discussions, partnerships, and consultant engagements. 8. Scientific Communication Support dissemination of scientific knowledge through publications, presentations, and training initiatives. Academic Qualification: Bachelors or Master's degree, equivalent or higher qualification within Life sciences/ Pharmacy/ MBBS /MD/ Healthcare Degree in alternative Medicine/ BDS with at least 10 years of experience in clinical development. Additional certification in Clinical Research or Regulatory Affairs is an advantage. Work Experience: 10+ years of experience in Clinical Development / Medical Affairs within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry . Proven experience in end-to-end clinical trial management and regulatory submissions . Experience in novel biologics, complex molecules, or global clinical programs preferred. Strong exposure to regulatory interactions (USFDA, EMA, CDSCO, PMDA, etc.) . Key Skills & Competencies: Strong clinical and scientific acumen In-depth knowledge of GCP, regulatory guidelines, and clinical trial processes Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills Strategic thinking and problem-solving ability Leadership and team management capability High attention to detail and data interpretation skills

title: OT Manager
description: Job Description: Operation Theatre (OT) Manager Job Summary The Operation Theatre (OT) Manager is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the Operation Theatre complex, ensuring the efficient delivery of high-quality surgical services while maintaining patient safety, regulatory compliance, and optimal resource utilization. The role involves managing OT staff, coordinating surgical schedules, ensuring equipment and consumables are available, and collaborating with surgeons, anesthetists, nursing teams, and hospital departments to deliver seamless perioperative care. Success in this role is measured by efficient OT utilization, adherence to patient safety and infection control standards, minimal surgery delays or cancellations, high clinical quality, and a positive experience for patients and clinicians. The OT Manager plays a critical role in supporting the hospital's surgical services and operational excellence. Key ResponsibilitiesOT Operations Management Oversee the daily functioning of all Operation Theatres to ensure smooth and efficient surgical services. Plan and coordinate OT schedules in collaboration with surgeons, anesthetists, and nursing teams. Monitor OT utilization and optimize theatre efficiency to minimize delays and cancellations. Ensure timely preparation of operating rooms before every procedure. Coordinate emergency surgeries while balancing scheduled elective procedures. Team Leadership Supervise, mentor, and manage OT nurses, technicians, attendants, and support staff. Prepare staff duty rosters and ensure adequate manpower across all shifts. Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and training sessions. Promote a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement. Patient Safety & Quality Ensure strict adherence to patient safety protocols, including WHO Surgical Safety Checklist. Monitor compliance with infection prevention and control practices. Ensure proper patient identification, surgical site verification, and safe handling of surgical specimens. Investigate incidents, near misses, and adverse events, and implement corrective actions. Equipment & Inventory Management Ensure availability and proper functioning of OT equipment and surgical instruments. Coordinate preventive maintenance and calibration with the Biomedical Engineering team. Monitor inventory levels of surgical consumables, implants, and sterile supplies. Coordinate procurement to prevent stock shortages and minimize wastage. Sterilization & Infection Control Work closely with CSSD to ensure timely sterilization and availability of instruments. Monitor OT cleaning protocols and environmental hygiene standards. Ensure compliance with NABH, biomedical waste management, and infection control guidelines. Coordination & Communication Liaise with surgeons, anesthetists, ICU, wards, emergency department, laboratory, radiology, pharmacy, and CSSD for smooth patient flow. Coordinate with admission, billing, and front office teams regarding surgical cases. Ensure effective communication with patients and families regarding OT-related processes whenever required. Compliance & Documentation Ensure complete and accurate OT documentation and maintenance of surgical records. Monitor compliance with hospital policies, legal requirements, and accreditation standards. Participate in internal audits, quality improvement initiatives, and accreditation activities. Financial & Operational Performance Monitor OT operational costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Track OT utilization, turnaround time, cancellation rates, and other operational KPIs. Prepare periodic reports and present operational insights to hospital leadership. Support initiatives to improve productivity, patient satisfaction, and clinical outcomes. QualificationsEducation Bachelor's Degree with relevant OT experience. Master's Degree in Hospital Administration (MHA) or MBA in Healthcare Management is preferred. Experience 5–8 years of experience in Operation Theatre management or perioperative services. Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial role in a multi-specialty hospital. Skills Strong leadership and people management skills. Excellent planning, scheduling, and organizational abilities. Sound knowledge of OT workflows, surgical procedures, and perioperative care. Thorough understanding of infection control, sterilization, and patient safety standards. Knowledge of NABH/JCI standards and healthcare regulations. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage emergencies and make quick operational decisions. Proficiency in Hospital Information Systems (HIS) and Microsoft Office. Certifications (Preferred) Certification in Operation Theatre Nursing or Perioperative Nursing. NABH/Internal Quality Auditor training. Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) OT Utilization Rate On-time Surgery Start Rate OT Turnaround Time Surgery Cancellation Rate Compliance with WHO Surgical Safety Checklist Infection Control Compliance Patient and Surgeon Satisfaction Scores Inventory Accuracy and Stock Availability Staff Productivity and Training Compliance NABH/Quality Audit Scores Skills: patient safety,ot operations management,theatre,surgical scheduling & coordination,infection,infection control,compliance,inventory & ot equipment management,nabh

title: General Manager Quality
description: Role Objective A key objective of this position is to lead and govern the Quality function at the manufacturing site, ensuring uncompromised product quality, patient safety, and compliance with global regulatory requirements (USFDA, EU-GMP, MHRA, WHO-GMP, TGA, and other regulated markets) across sterile injectable operations. The role is responsible for building a robust Quality Management System, driving a strong quality culture, ensuring inspection readiness, and enabling business continuity through consistent, compliant, and right-first-time manufacturing and testing of injectable products. Desired Candidate Profile B.Pharm / M.Pharm / M.Sc. (Chemistry or Microbiology) or equivalent; a Ph.D. or additional certification in Quality/Regulatory Affairs will be an added advantage. 18–22 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance/Quality Control, with a mandatory and demonstrable background in pharma injectable (sterile/parenteral) manufacturing – vials, ampoules, PFS, lyophilized products, or biologics. Prior experience of successfully hosting and clearing regulatory inspections (USFDA, EU-GMP, MHRA, WHO, ANVISA, etc.) at an injectable facility. Proven track record in leading site quality operations for a large-scale, high-volume sterile manufacturing plant. Strong exposure to aseptic processing, isolator/RABS technology, media fill validation, and environmental monitoring programs. Demonstrated leadership in managing large, multi-level quality teams (QA, QC, Microbiology, Validation, Regulatory Compliance). Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to interface with regulators, corporate quality, and site leadership. Roles & Responsibilities: Provide strategic leadership to the site Quality function (QA, QC, Microbiology, Validation, and Documentation) in line with corporate quality objectives. Own and drive the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring alignment with global GMP/GDP standards. Set annual quality objectives, KPIs, and improvement plans for the site. Ensure regulatory compliance and inspection readiness for all applicable health authorities. Lead preparation for and hosting of USFDA, EU-GMP, MHRA, WHO-GMP, and other customer/regulatory audits. Ensure timely closure of audit observations, CAPAs, and warning letter responses, where applicable. Govern quality systems specific to sterile/injectable manufacturing. Oversee aseptic process validation, media fills, environmental monitoring, and sterility assurance programs. Ensure robust control over deviations, OOS/OOT, change controls, CAPA, and market complaints. Drive Quality Risk Management across manufacturing, packaging, and laboratory operations. Implement risk-based approaches (QRM/ICH Q9) for critical process and product quality attributes. Lead validation and qualification programs. Ensure equipment, utility, process, and cleaning validations are executed and maintained in a validated state. Build and mentor a high-performing Quality organization. Develop talent, succession plans, and training programs to strengthen quality capability at the site. Partner with cross-functional teams (Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs) to ensure quality is embedded across the value chain. Report site quality performance, risks, and compliance status to senior leadership and corporate quality on a periodic basis. Functional Skills Required In-depth knowledge of cGMP, GLP, GDP, and global regulatory guidelines (USFDA, 21 CFR 211, EU Annex 1, ICH Q7-Q10). Strong command of sterile/injectable manufacturing processes – aseptic filling, lyophilization, terminal sterilization, and container closure integrity. Expertise in Quality Management Systems: deviations, CAPA, change control, OOS/OOT investigations, and complaint management. Sound knowledge of validation and qualification (process, cleaning, equipment, computer system validation). Experience with data integrity requirements (ALCOA+) and computerized system compliance (21 CFR Part 11). Working knowledge of Quality Risk Management tools (FMEA, HACCP, QRM as per ICH Q9). Proficiency in handling regulatory audits, customer audits, and corporate quality reviews independently. Familiarity with statistical tools and trending techniques for quality data analysis. Behavioral Skills Required Strong leadership and people management capability to lead large, cross-functional teams. High integrity and uncompromising commitment to quality and patient safety. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with regulators, senior management, and cross-functional stakeholders. Sound decision-making and problem-solving ability, especially under regulatory and business pressure. Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution capability. Resilience, composure, and the ability to manage crisis situations (e.g., audits, recalls, market complaints) effectively. Strong ownership, accountability, and a continuous improvement mindset. Team Size to be Handled: Manage a team of 35 Quality professionals, including 3-4 direct reportees at the Sr. Manager and Manager levels, reporting to the VP Quality. title: Competitive Applications and Grants Researcher & Writer
description: About Company: Kinexcs is an AI-driven digital health platform and wearables company with a mission to enable and empower people for mobility and a better quality of life. It is focused on reducing the burden of musculoskeletal conditions, which affects about 25% of the world's population. Their 1st product, KIMIA Recover, a continuous monitoring device for the knee joint, has obtained FDA Approval, CE marking and HSA approval, and booked revenues from large implant companies and hospitals. It has recently won the Johnson and Johnson Quickfire Challenge Award and has been selected by the Cedars Sinai Healthcare System (#1 in California and #5 in the USA according to US world rankings) for investment and commercial projects using the two products of the company. KIMIA Recover is a comprehensive recovery management solution providing reduction in number of hospital visits and complications for Total Knee Replacement Patients. The product was also the National Winner and International Top 20 of the prestigious James Dyson Award, and has gained traction with major public hospitals and orthopedic clinics.Their digital therapy platform, consisting of KIMIA Assess, uses artificial intelligence technology for digital MSK assessment and therapy. This platform is capable of providing pre-consultation assessments and real-time exercise guidance and feedback to musculoskeletal patients, and is being adopted by some of the largest private healthcare providers in the region, along with large corporate players. About the Job: As a Competitive Applications and Grants Researcher & Writer at Kinexcs, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and securing funding opportunities through competitive applications, grants, and awards. You will research relevant calls, craft compelling proposals, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to highlight Kinexcs unique value proposition. Your work will directly support the company's innovation and expansion by strengthening its financial foundation and global recognition. What You Will Do: Research & Analysis Proactively identify and track relevant funding opportunities including government grants, research programs, innovation challenges, and international competitions. Analyze eligibility criteria, requirements, and competitive landscapes for each opportunity. Maintain a pipeline/database of upcoming opportunities with deadlines and strategic fit. Proposal Writing & Submission Develop high-quality, tailored grant applications, proposals, and award submissions. Collaborate with product, clinical, R&D, and business teams to gather technical and business inputs. Ensure applications align with organizational strategy, mission, and product innovation roadmap. Edit, proofread, and refine submissions to ensure clarity, persuasiveness, and compliance. Strategy & Collaboration Work closely with leadership to prioritize opportunities based on funding potential and strategic alignment. Create templates, best practices, and documentation to streamline future submissions. Provide insights into trends in funding landscapes (e.g., healthtech, AI, medtech grants). Build relationships with funding bodies, grant officers, and program managers to stay updated. Tracking & Reporting Maintain accurate records of applications submitted, status updates, and outcomes. Track key performance indicators such as win rates and funding amounts secured. Prepare reports and updates for senior leadership on grant activities and pipeline. What You Need: Required Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Business, Communications, or related field. 3–5 years of proven experience in grant writing, proposal development, or research funding. Strong track record of successful applications to competitive grants, awards, or research programs. Excellent research, writing, and editing skills with attention to detail. Ability to translate complex scientific/technical information into persuasive, accessible language. Strong organizational and project management skills to manage multiple deadlines. Preferred Experience in healthcare, medtech, or digital health sectors. Familiarity with global funding programs (EU Horizon, NIH, SBIR, H2020, IMDA, EnterpriseSG, etc.). Knowledge of intellectual property, regulatory, or R&D processes. Prior experience collaborating with clinicians, researchers, or technical teams on applications.

title: HR Executive / Senior Executive

This role is responsible for full-cycle healthcare talent acquisition (doctors, nursing staff, clinical, and administrative teams), shift/duty roster alignment, healthcare statutory compliance, employee relations, and NABH/JCI accreditation audit documentation. Key Responsibilities Healthcare Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Oversee end-to-end recruitment for medical staff (Resident Doctors, Consultants), nursing personnel, paramedical staff, and administrative teams. Coordinate credentialing, background verification, medical council registration checks, and license verification during hiring. Conduct structured hospital orientation and onboarding programs for clinical and non-clinical new hires. HR Operations & Workforce Management Maintain comprehensive employee records, doctor agreements, nurse registration details, and personnel files in the HRMS database. Coordinate with Nursing Management and Department Heads for duty roster management, shift allocations, attendance tracking, and leave administration. Process monthly payroll inputs (biometric attendance, overtime, night-shift allowances, and doctor payout variables). Compliance & Hospital Accreditation Ensure strict adherence to healthcare labor laws, statutory compliance (PF, ESI, Minimum Wages, Gratuity, Maternity Benefits). Lead HR documentation, credentialing files, and staff training records required for NABH / JCI accreditation audits. Employee Relations & Performance Management Serve as a key point of contact to resolve staff grievances, shift-related issues, and inter-departmental concerns. Coordinate annual/semi-annual performance appraisal processes across clinical and operational departments. Facilitate employee engagement drives, nurse appreciation initiatives, and soft-skills/patient-handling training sessions. Requirements & Qualifications Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR (MBA / MHA / MSW / PGDM in HR). Experience: 3-6 years of HR operational experience, with at least 2+ years specifically in a hospital or healthcare setup. Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of hospital staffing structures (OPD, IPD, ICU, OT, Emergency). Familiarity with NABH HR standards, labor laws, and medical council verification rules. Working knowledge of HRMS, attendance software, and MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables).

title: Associate Director, Master Data Stewardship
description: Job Description The Opportunity Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy. A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers. Role Overview As an Associate Director, you will provide strategic direction and business-facing leadership for customer master data stewardship. You will define and advance stewardship operating models, partner with business and technology leaders, and ensure that customer data governance is executed effectively across systems and regions. You will also lead and develop a team of stewardship professionals while remaining actively engaged in the operational and strategic aspects of customer master data management. This is not solely a people management role; it requires deep subject matter expertise, strong business partnership, and the ability to influence stewardship practices, data quality outcomes, and automation priorities across the enterprise. Role Description Stewardship Strategy and Operating Model Define and drive the customer master data stewardship strategy in alignment with enterprise data governance objectives and business priorities. Establish and evolve the stewardship operating model, including roles, responsibilities, processes, controls, and escalation paths. Ensure stewardship practices support a trusted customer golden record and enable harmonization, survivorship, and consistency across domains. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to assess current-state challenges and shape future-state stewardship capabilities. Translate business needs into scalable stewardship processes, controls, and service expectations. Governance, Standards, and Data Quality Leadership Oversee the enforcement of master data standards, hierarchies, code sets, survivorship rules, and data quality expectations for customer data. Monitor stewardship effectiveness through data quality metrics, issue trends, SLA performance, and operational dashboards. Lead root cause analysis and remediation initiatives for recurring customer data issues, duplicates, conflicts, and process gaps. Ensure appropriate governance for sensitive customer master data, including PII and PHI, in partnership with the MDM lead and compliance stakeholders. Drive continuous improvement in data quality management and stewardship controls. Business Partnership and Stakeholder Engagement Serve as a senior business-facing leader for customer master data stewardship across commercial and enterprise functions. Build trusted relationships with business leaders, data owners, technology partners, and governance teams to align stewardship priorities and resolve issues. Influence decision-making on customer data policy, process design, and operational trade-offs. Represent stewardship in enterprise forums, governance councils, and transformation initiatives. Communicate risks, progress, and recommendations in a clear, concise, and executive-ready manner. Lead delivery teams and review technical designs and code (if required) Engage senior stakeholders to align data standards, priorities, and roadmap Provide thought leadership on MDM best practices Operational Leadership and Service Management Oversee day-to-day stewardship operations for customer master data, including match/merge, issue triage, lifecycle management, and exception handling. Ensure effective management of customer data requests, system impacts, and downstream dependencies. Monitor and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLAs), operational commitments, and escalation management. Support system upgrades, release readiness, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for MDM changes and enhancements. Ensure operational discipline through documented procedures, controls, and performance review mechanisms. Automation, AI Enablement, and Innovation Champion automation and agentic AI initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve stewardship scalability and responsiveness. Identify opportunities to automate validation, routing, issue classification, reporting, and exception management activities. Partner with technology teams to evaluate and implement intelligent workflows and decision-support capabilities. Promote a culture of innovation within stewardship operations, balancing control with efficiency and scalability. Support adoption of tools and processes that enhance business value and reduce operational friction. Team Leadership and Talent Development Lead, coach, and develop stewardship team members to build functional expertise, accountability, and high performance. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and customer-focused team culture. Set clear expectations, provide feedback, and support professional growth and succession planning. Ensure effective workload management, role clarity, and team alignment to business priorities. While people management is a key part of the role, the position remains deeply engaged in strategic stewardship, stakeholder partnership, and operational execution. Who You Are Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 14+ years of experience in data stewardship, master data management, data governance, or related disciplines. Proven experience working with Commercial Pharma domains (HCP/HCO, affiliations, sales, CRM) and leading customer master data stewardship in a complex, regulated enterprise environment. Strong hands-on experience with Informatica MDM. Strong SQL skills are required. Proven experience driving stewardship strategy, governance execution, and data quality improvements. Experience partnering with business leaders and technology teams in a matrixed organization. Experience with merge/unmerge processes, release management, and User Acceptance Testing. Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Veeva CRM or comparable systems. Strong understanding of SOP compliance, operational controls, and data privacy requirements. Demonstrated ability to lead teams while remaining hands-on in strategic and operational stewardship work. Strong executive communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills. Strong experience for automation, workflow optimization, or AI-enabled operational transformation is preferred. Who We Are We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world. What We Look For Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. FemLyra is building a trusted digital healthcare ecosystem covering women's wellness, menstrual health, fertility, pregnancy care, preventive healthcare, mental wellness, nutrition, dermatology, online doctor consultations, lab test booking, health reports, and AI-enabled educational wellness support. The organization aims to combine clinical expertise, patient-first care, technology, and innovation to address unmet needs in women's health and wellness. This role requires both medical leadership and investment commitment. Investment and Equity This is a serious investment-based co-founder opportunity. Mandatory Investment Commitment: ₹20 lakh Proposed Equity: 10%, or as mutually discussed and legally documented Please apply only if you are highly interested in joining FemLyra as an active co-founder and are ready to discuss the mandatory ₹20 lakh investment commitment. title: Senior Director of Enterprise AI Scaling and Innovation
description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Position Overview For more than 140 years, Eli Lilly and Company has been committed to discovering and developing medicines that improve lives. Facing an accelerating pace of digital and AI transformation across healthcare, Lilly established Lilly Bengaluru India (LBI) as a strategic investment in future-ready capabilities: a globally connected, agile and innovation-driven organization, deeply attuned to the evolving needs of patients and healthcare systems. Within it, the Commercialization Capabilities organization enables Lilly's commercial teams worldwide across the end-to-end commercialization lifecycle, spanning five core focus areas: Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A), Global Operations Sales Organization (GOSO), Global Content Hub (GCH), Experience Activation (EXPA), and Commercial Learning Services (CLS). Lilly's enterprise AI agenda is delivered through NOVA (Next-generation Organizational Value through AI), the program through which AI initiatives are submitted, shaped, governed and scaled across GCCI, Medical Capabilities, GOSO and IBU Central. To further elevate LBI's strategic impact, we are seeking an accomplished AI leader to serve as Senior Director of Enterprise AI Scaling and Innovation. The role leads NOVA's global rollout and operational execution across these four organizations, working directly with their senior leaders to shape AI submissions into work that can credibly reach enterprise scale. Beyond NOVA, it drives Lilly's most critical cross-functional AI initiatives — including frontier programs such as SAGE, focused on agentification within brand launches — and maintains the enterprise's line of sight into a fast-moving external technology landscape. This is a deep-domain senior technical leadership role. The incumbent brings independent judgment on AI architecture, feasibility and cost-to-scale, and is the person the enterprise relies on to distinguish an AI initiative that will scale from one that will not. Success depends on technical credibility and the willingness to redirect or stop well-sponsored work that cannot reach production. This position reports to the Vice President and Global Head of LBI Commercialization Capabilities and operates with an enterprise mandate across the organizations NOVA serves. Primary Responsibilities NOVA Rollout & Operational Execution (50%) Own NOVA's rollout and operational execution across the four organizations, establishing it as the route through which enterprise AI work is shaped, prioritized, built and scaled. Partner with senior leaders to shape AI submissions against the enterprise bar for scalability — value hypothesis, data readiness, architecture, cost-to-scale and path to production — reshaping what's unready and redirecting, consolidating or stopping what cannot clear it, so work reaches governed production rather than stalling as a proof of concept. Maintain the governance that makes speed safe (risk tiering, decision gates, responsible-AI standards, model and agent oversight), and raise the AI fluency of the leaders you advise so they sponsor AI work with realistic expectations of cost, risk and value. Own the value framework and KPIs that hold the NOVA portfolio accountable to realized impact, and help lead the organizational change, culture and talent development. Drive Next-Generation Frontier & Cross-Functional Programs (40%) Lead the cross-functional AI initiatives that span organizational boundaries, have no natural single owner, and will not succeed without senior technical leadership. Drive frontier programs from concept to a defensible path to deployment: define the technical thesis, pressure-test feasibility, sequence milestones and secure cross-functional investment. Advance Lilly's agentic mission — multi-agent architectures, orchestration, tool use, evaluation and human-in-the-loop design — and resolve the architectural, data and operating-model dependencies that block scale, working across Tech@Lilly, legal, compliance and privacy. Assess the External Environment and Accelerate External Innovation (10%) Maintain a rigorous, current read of the external AI landscape — models, agents, tooling and applied practice within and beyond life sciences — and route it back through NOVA in actionable form that shapes live submissions, architecture choices and investment sequencing. Maintain an active map of companies, including startups, that can accelerate Lilly's agentic mission, and partner with Procurement, Legal, Privacy and Information Security on a fast-track evaluation pathway — pre-negotiated terms, right-sized risk assessment, time-boxed evaluation — so promising partners aren't lost to a multi-month onboarding cycle. Minimum Qualification Requirements A postgraduate qualification (MBA, MSc, M.Pharm or equivalent), or an equivalent depth of professional experience. 15+ years of progressive leadership across enterprise strategy, transformation and technology, in pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences, or other complex regulated global enterprises, including substantial experience leading AI initiatives. A track record of taking AI from concept to production at enterprise scale across multiple business functions — including the architectural, data and responsible-AI decisions required to deploy safely — with measured business impact, not strategy alone. Proven success as the senior technical voice on large, cross-functional initiatives within Global Capability Centers and/or Fortune-100 enterprises — including the standing to challenge and redirect executive-sponsored work, and a track record of influencing decisions across a matrixed, global organization. Deep, current expertise across the AI and generative-AI lifecycle — large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic and multi-agent systems, evaluation methodology and the data foundations they depend on — sufficient to independently assess feasibility, interrogate architecture and cost-to-scale, and hold your own with engineering and research leaders. This is not a hands-on engineering role, but it demands genuine technical depth; program and process-management capability alone will not suffice. Sound judgment on enterprise AI governance, operational risk and performance measurement, and on where to trade speed against trust and compliance. Exceptional executive presence and communication: the ability to influence executives, align diverse teams, explain complex technical and risk factors in clear business terms, lead through ambiguity, and develop others. Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technology vendors and startups on technical merit and build co-innovation partnerships that convert into enterprise adoption, working with procurement, legal and security functions to compress evaluation and onboarding cycles without weakening enterprise risk standards. Preferred Qualifications Fluency with recognized responsible-AI and governance frameworks (for example, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act). Experience elevating Global Capability Centers from delivery into innovation and value creation. Familiarity with Lilly's commercial model or other regulated, global operating environments. A background in digital product, platform or automation delivery. Recognized project or process-excellence credentials (PMP, Lean or Six Sigma) are a plus.
